text: Trace and timings on 6d58fdba1, src unchanged (evidence/startup-phase-timings.json, evidence/probes/). Between start and ready the cell worker runs jco transpileBytes (3.4-3.6 s), capComponentCoreMemory (3-5 ms), glue import (5-10 ms), core compile of the 12.9 MB module (11-15 ms, lazy) and instantiate+ready (5-20 ms); spawn is 47-57 ms. Transpile is 97% of start and is a pure function of bytes, jco version, world and instantiation mode, repeated cold in every fresh worker (cold 4.0 s, warm 3.1 s). Four concurrent transpiles on 2 cores: wall 13.4-13.7 s, CPU 5.9-6.0 s; four concurrent starts on 2 cores with today's runtime: 4/4 START_FAILED at the 10 s bound. Instantiate-only start (transpile precomputed): 104 ms alone, 0.33-0.66 s 4x on 2 cores, 1.9 s 8x on 1 core. On expiry waitForReady terminates the worker (START_ERR 37-70 ms after the bound, process exits; no orphan); error is request_cell_start_failed 'Component startup timed out' without phase/budget/elapsed; driver flattens it into a status string and the lifecycle projects the replica FAILED; any re-drive redoes the discarded transpile. The bound is a work bound labelled as liveness.

Local reproduction of the hosted signature: taskset -c 0,1 node scripts/run-classified-test-files.js h1 h2 h3 q4 (ordinary lane, jobs=4) -> h2, h3, q4 not ok with wait_bound_spent STARTUP_TIMEOUT_MS boundMs 10000; h1 ok 110 s. h1 alone on the same two cores passes in 32.7 s.

Design recommendation (evidence/design-note.md): option (c) node-side, content-addressed, single-flight derivation owned by WasiComponentCellRuntime, triggered at driver prepare and awaited by start; the cell start becomes instantiate-only under the unchanged fixed 10 s liveness bound with typed START_FAILED {phase, budgetMs, elapsedMs}; derivation bounded by admission size, one lane per node, a byte-proportional CPU-time ceiling via worker.cpuUsage and owner cancellation, with typed derivation_failed/derivation_exhausted. Rejected: (a) calibrated budget and (d) configurable budget still kill-and-redo under contention; (b) leaves transpile unbounded and repeated; client-side precompile would run deployer-authored JS beside host imports; the test machine factor in src is a forbidden test-only route and the hardware-relative epic leaves src timers alone. Open parameter for the lead: DERIVATION_CPU_MS_PER_MIB (proposed 2000 plus 5000 fixed). Awaiting the lead's decision; not started.

R17 routed finding, not this quest: q10 postgres-compatibility-certification-matrix fails off this controller because the live generated matrix is deepStrictEqual-compared (test line 1254) with docs/postgres-compatibility-matrix.json, which pins driverVersions.psql 14.24 (this controller); the hosted runner has psql 16.15, so driverVersions and matrixDigest differ. The logged refusals 'multiple statements in one query are not supported' and 'OFFSET without LIMIT is unsupported' are the expected negative controls (asserted 0A000/XX000), not the failure. Owner: postgres-compatibility-certification-matrix quest / src/query/pg/postgres-compatibility-matrix.js and its test (client-environment dependence of a committed artifact).

History: STARTUP_TIMEOUT_MS = 10_000 introduced by 9b430a9a3 (2026-07-23), unchanged since (54dd2d7ce only added the ends-on comment and reportWaitBoundSpent). The same failure was found 2026-08-17 in restore-deterministic-cloud-gate and explicitly left as an untouched product question; it was resolved by the external-toolchain resource class (jobs=1). The nine 0.5 service test files are classified ordinary (jobs=4) in test/shards/resource-classes.json, unlike their toolchain siblings service-cell-worker-modes and service-cell-bridge-roundtrip: that is the immediate hosted trigger (routed to the test resource classification owner, deterministic-cloud-gate epic), while the product defect (kill-and-redo of progressing CPU work under load, R12) remains and is this quest's scope.

Lead decisions 2026-11-02: (1) option (c) approved as designed. (2) Derivation CPU ceiling = DERIVATION_CPU_MS_PER_MIB 2000 + DERIVATION_CPU_FIXED_MS 5000, a production-owned constant pair in the derivation module. Derivation of the numbers: measured cold transpile 3.4-3.6 s wall / 4.1 s CPU per 12.3 MiB (12912649 bytes) on the 20-core controller, i.e. ~0.33 s CPU/MiB alone and ~0.48 s CPU/MiB at 4x contention on 2 cores; 2 s/MiB + 5 s gives ~29.6 s for this component, ~6x this host, and ~517 s for the 256 MiB admission cap. Exhaustion is typed (request_cell_component_derivation_exhausted) and permanent for that digest (no automatic redo), cleared only by a new digest or operator action. Considered and rejected: size limit only without CPU ceiling, because a pathological component would then hold the node's single derivation lane without bound (R13). (3) Red tests 1-6 approved; test 6 (h1, h2, h3, q4 at four jobs pinned to two cores: taskset -c 0,1 node scripts/run-classified-test-files.js test/service/h1-pinned-hono-component-proof.test.js test/service/h2-hono-source-ir-deployment-cutover.test.js test/service/h3-fetch-ingress-and-scoped-client.test.js test/service/q4-call-bounded-structured-partials.test.js) is the production-bound witness of the R12 claim.
